prompt: Add a search box to the Archived screen so I can find an old agent by its name or task.
Let me hide tool results in the agent log when I only want to read the conversation.
Show a character count on the Select text screen.
Add a way to copy the filename from the file viewer.
Add a quick way to show only messages from one agent in the feed.
Let me snooze an ask for a week by typing 1w, or two weeks with 2w.
Recognize SVG and WebM attachments instead of treating them as generic binary files.
Show how many attachments I have selected in the composer.
Add a Copy goal action on the goal screen.
Add a workspace description field that I can set and see from the CLI.
Let me select several archived agents and unarchive them together.
Add search within the agent log, with next and previous match buttons.
Add a compact mode for agent rows so more agents fit on my phone.
Let me bookmark messages in an agent conversation and jump back to them later.
Give the feed a pause button so I can read it without new messages moving everything around.
Add JSON output to the workspaces command for scripts.
Add a command to export one agent conversation as a plain text file.
Let me mute notifications from an entire workspace.
Let me reorder attachments before sending a message.
Let me reorder my saved servers and remember that order.
Let me enter a custom snooze duration for an ask in the app.
Add a CLI option to show only the last few lines of the goal notes for an agent.
Add an app setting to make code blocks use a larger font.
Add a few saved task templates to the New agent screen, with a way to save my own.
Add JSON output for open asks so I can feed them into another tool.
Let me copy a group chat roster as plain text.
Add a personal note on each agent that I can edit in the app and read from the CLI.
Let me schedule a message to a local agent for later and cancel it before it goes out.
Add tags to agents, with a tag filter in the app and a CLI command to manage them.
Let me search the conversations already loaded on my phone when the server is offline.
Keep a history of goal status changes and show it on the goal screen.
Add a dry-run bulk archive command for all stopped agents in a workspace.
Add a Drafts screen where I can find and reopen my unsent messages across servers.
Add a CLI view of queued remote messages with an option to cancel one that has not been delivered.
Let me share an agent conversation as a text file from the app, including older messages.
Make the empty Archived screen explain how agents end up there.
Use a more readable font size in the log: 14 points with a 20-point line height.
Keep the Select text screen open after Copy all so I can keep selecting text.
Show up to five lines of each ask in the agents list instead of three.
Show attachment sizes below 1 MB with one decimal place in KB.
Show a zero-second goal interval as 0 seconds instead of 0s in human-readable duration output.
Make new devices group notification bursts for 30 seconds by default rather than a minute.
Sort archived agents alphabetically instead of by archive date.
When an agent is stopped, call it Not running in the app rather than stopped.
Keep sanitized attachment filenames up to 120 characters rather than 100, still preserving the extension.
Keep agents in the recently active bucket for five minutes instead of one.
Make multiword agent searches match words separately, even if they appear in different parts of the task or name.
An agent with an open unsnoozed ask should never get folded into Idle.
Group the feed by day and show a date heading above each group.
Ask me for confirmation before unarchiving an agent.
When loading older log entries fails, put Retry beside the Earlier control instead of a persistent error at the bottom.
Require explicit units in goal intervals, so 90s works but a bare 90 asks me to specify a unit.
Accept decimal hours when snoozing, like 1.5h.
When Allow urgent is on, let urgent asks from muted agents come through too. Normal messages should stay muted.
Include each workspace working directory in the error when an agent name is ambiguous across workspaces.
When I enter localhost without a scheme while pairing, use HTTP instead of HTTPS.
Use a filename extension as the fallback when an upload says its media type is unknown/unknown.
Show line numbers in code blocks, but leave them out when I copy the code.
Give failed file previews a visible Retry button.
Show snoozed asks in their own collapsed section below active asks.
Show stopped and running agent counts separately in the workspace list.
Add status:running and status:done filters to agent search, and let me combine them with ordinary words.
Let notification quiet hours use different schedules on weekdays and weekends.
Make the idle-fold preference specific to each server instead of sharing it across all servers.
Make failed goal cycles stop retrying automatically after five consecutive failures and explain why.
Let send all exclude selected agents with repeatable --except options.
Add a Retry all failed messages action for the conversation I am looking at.
After a remote message has been waiting a day, stop retrying and tell its sender it expired.
When the active server is unavailable, offer to switch to another saved server that is reachable.
Warn me if a goal changed on the server while I was editing it, instead of silently overwriting the newer text.
A message I have already read still counts as unread when its timestamp exactly matches the read marker. Please fix that.
Quiet hours from 10pm to 7am seem to do nothing overnight. Please fix them.
Typing 90 to snooze an ask makes it reappear almost immediately rather than after an hour and a half.
A photo attached as PICTURE.PNG is showing up as a generic file. Lowercase names seem fine.
Agent search used to find names without me worrying about capital letters. Now searching ALICE does not find alice.
The workspace chooser sometimes lists the same workspace several times. Can you fix that?
A draft to master on one server shows up when I open master on another server. Please keep them separate.
An agent that has finished is labeled stopped in the app. Please show that it is done.
Long attachment filenames are losing their extension when they are uploaded. Please preserve it.
Reading a conversation on another computer sometimes does not clear its unread badge here, even after the read state syncs.
Running the CLI inside a nested workspace picks the outer workspace instead. Please fix workspace selection.
I have /work/project configured as a workspace, but commands from /work/project-old are being routed into it too.
After re-pairing a server using a URL with a trailing slash, I end up with two saved entries for it.
After installing an update, drafts from a much older session sometimes come back. Please stop restoring stale state.
I turned notifications off, but urgent asks are still pushing through. Please respect the off setting.
An old snooze from my other computer replaces a more recent Remind me now action. Please fix the sync behavior.
My quiet hours happen at the wrong time when my phone is west of UTC. Please make them follow the phone time.
Unarchiving an agent whose name includes a workspace fails from the app, while simple names work.
Sometimes a message at the end of a live log is missing or garbled while it is still being written. Please fix live log reading.
After a remote computer reconnects, queued messages arrive in reverse order. Please keep the original send order.
When sending a message fails, it disappears completely instead of staying available to retry. Please keep failed messages.
Two computers both have an agent called worker, and reading one clears the other conversation too.
Removing one attachment sometimes removes another copy of the same filename too. Please remove only the one I tapped.
When an agent restarts during a turn, older messages sometimes get handled after newer ones. Please preserve delivery order.
Some messages stay waiting forever after the agent has answered them, especially around a restart. Please fix completion tracking.
After reconnecting, an agent occasionally seems to forget a message it had already accepted. Please investigate duplicate acceptance events.
Restarting the gateway makes the phone reload its whole conversation history even when nothing changed.
Two identical messages sent at the same time collapse into one on the phone after reconnecting. Please preserve both.
If I switch servers while a request is in flight, the previous server sometimes overwrites what I see on the new one.
Cancelling an upload leaves partial files behind on disk. Please clean up failed uploads properly.
